$doc: Cross-implementation test vectors for the practice-effect experiment's block allocator.
The backend (TS, apps/api/src/lib/experiment-registry.ts) and the teams CLI (Go,
promptster-cli/experiment) both assert against THIS file rather than against each
other's prose. A mismatch here is the two halves disagreeing about what arm an
engineer was shown, which is the one failure the assignment log cannot survive.
Regenerate deliberately: changing a vector re-labels history.

algorithm.position: count of prior landed rows under the allocation key
algorithm.seed: sha256(experimentKey NUL orgId NUL engineerUserId NUL stratum NUL decimal(block))
algorithm.stream: h_i = sha256(seed || uint32be(i)), i = 0,1,2,... concatenated, consumed 4 bytes at a time
algorithm.shuffle: Fisher-Yates over cells in DECLARATION order: for j = n-1 down to 1: k = uint32be(next4) % (j+1); swap
